content: where $\Theta $ is the set of all model parameters related to NER, and $\Theta ^{\prime }$ is the set of the remaining parameters which are only related to the worker discriminator, $\mathbf {X}$ , $\mathbf {\bar{y}}$ and $\bar{z}$ are the input sentence, the crowd-annotated NE labels and the corresponding annotator for this annotation, respectively. It is worth noting that the parameters of the common Bi-LSTM are included in the set of $\Theta $ by definition.
